review:
Army of Ares is a war-god slot built around Wrath Reels. When a Wrath scatter lands it expands into a wild reel with an additive multiplier from 2x to 300x, and drops up to five extra wilds onto random positions. Multipliers on several Wrath Reels in the same win add together, left to right.

Only one Wrath symbol can land per reel, so the realistic best case is two or three reels lining up. The Fear and Flame bonus ensures at least one Wrath Reel on every spin, which keeps the bonus active. The maximum is 15,000x.
